title: Senior Data Scientist, Growth (f/m/x)
description:
About the role: What's in the Box

The Growth Alliance powers HelloFresh’s marketing engine, from media investment and in-channel optimization, to the conversion funnel, to how and when we communicate with customers. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will design and ship statistical and machine learning models that turn data from experiments, campaigns, and customer behavior into decisions that directly move the business: how we spend our marketing budget, how we convert visitors into customers, and how we personalize every touchpoint along the way.

You’ll join one of several teams within the alliance, spanning marketing measurement and attribution, channel optimisation, funnel optimisation and decisioning on customer communications and messaging. Across all of these topics, the through line is the same: rigorous modeling, close collaboration with engineering and marketing stakeholders, and a bias toward shipping models that work in production, not just in a notebook.

To succeed in this role, you should be a curious, pragmatic problem solver who relentlessly prioritizes based on impact, is comfortable with statistical uncertainty, and can translate a fuzzy business question into a concrete, testable model.

At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

  • Design, build, and take ownership of statistical and machine learning models, from data collection through to production, closely aligning the approach with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate within cross-functional teams (engineering, product, marketing) to translate business objectives into concrete, data-driven strategies.
  • Experimentation: design tests, define success metrics and guardrails, and interpret results while accounting for statistical uncertainty, noise, and bias.
  • Continuously iterate and refine your technical approach, monitor model performance, data reliability, and drift once in production.
  • Retrieve, manipulate, and analyze large, heterogeneous datasets, and build the data pipelines your models depend on.
  • Think beyond the immediate ask to find new ways to improve the data products delivered to stakeholders.
  • As a senior member of the team, jump in to help solve problems as they arise, and support and coach more junior data scientists.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients 

  • Proven track record of scientific work through a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in statistics, physics, economics, mathematics, data science, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3+ years of professional experience as a (senior) data scientist or in a related quantitative role, ideally in e-commerce, marketing, or a comparably high-traffic, consumer-facing environment.
  • Strong marketing and/or growth domain knowledge, with experience applying statistical models such as regressors and classifiers, and interpreting experiment results under real-world uncertainty.
  • Fluency in Python and its scientific stack (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib); comfortable retrieving and analyzing data with SQL. Experience with Databricks/Spark is a plus.
  • Familiarity with software engineering practices and tools (Git, Docker, AWS or similar cloud environments).
  • Comfortable using recent Gen AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) to design and build solutions in a structured and pragmatic manner.
  • A critical thinker and creative problem solver who is comfortable proposing and prioritizing multiple solutions based on effort and likely impact.
  • A collaborative team player with exceptional communication skills, able to work with stakeholders from different backgrounds in an international environment.

Nice to have (domain specific), if you find yourself in one of the below, it’s a huge plus!

  • Measurement & attribution: experience with media mix models, attribution modeling, or incrementality measurement; Bayesian forecasting and estimating model uncertainty.
  • Search or Social channel optimization: experience with the Google/Meta ecosystem or other paid channels, forecasting algorithms, portfolio optimization, or Vector Autoregression.
  • Conversion & personalization: experience building decisioning or recommendation models that run in production behind high-traffic conversion funnels; customer segmentation and behavioral data.
  • Messaging & send decisioning: direct experience with reinforcement learning or contextual bandits (e.g. Thompson Sampling, epsilon-greedy), off-policy/counterfactual evaluation, or CRM and marketing decisioning use cases.

What we offer: The Toppings

  • Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.
  • Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.
  • Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.
  • End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

title: Associate Director, Paid Strategy (all genders)
description:
The role

Global Paid Marketing owns how HelloFresh Group buys customers across its portfolio of brands and markets. The team spans Paid Social, Paid Search, Display & Video, Partnerships & Affiliates, Creative Strategy and the Creators program, and steers one of the largest acquisition budgets in direct-to-consumer. We are rebuilding the organization around fewer, stronger channel leaders and an AI-first way of working, and this role is central to making that model run.

We are looking for an Associate Director of Paid Strategy to own the strategy, planning and operating backbone of Global Paid Marketing. Reporting to the Head of Global Paid Marketing, you will set how the paid portfolio plans its budget, runs its business reviews and prioritizes and delivers its biggest bets.

Channel leaders own their numbers. You own the system around them: the plan they commit to, the cadence that holds them to it, the cross-channel programs no single team owns, and the insightsthat turns many channels and dozens of entities into one clear view of the business. It is a role with unusual breadth and visibility, built for someone who wants to understand how a large paid organization is run, not just how one channel performs.

You will work directly with the paid leadership team, with StratOps as your closest partner: StratOps sets the company-wide growth agenda and governance, and you translate it into how paid team plans, operates and reports, then bring the paid view back into that agenda. You will also partner closely with Finance, Analytics, HR and Brand. This role is primarily designed as an Individual Contributor position: ; your impact  comes from the quality of your thinking, the rigor of your follow-through and the trust you earn.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

Paid strategy and planning

  • Own the planning cycle for the global paid portfolio: annual Business Plan, half-year budgets and monthly MBT re-forecasts, from channel-mix and entity allocation through to CAC and volume guardrails.
  • Partner with StratOps and Finance so paid commitments tie to company targets, and pressure-test every submission based on run-rates and data-driven assumptions  
  • Shape the multi-year paid strategy: where to invest, where to pull back, and which capabilities the organization needs to build.

Operating rhythm and governance

  • Design and run the operating cadence of the paid organization: weekly and monthly business reviews, QBRs, leadership team meetings and senior leadership steerings.
  • Set agendas, write or commission pre-reads, and own the decision and action log so every meeting ends with an owner and a date, and every commitment is followed through.
  • Define the KPIs, targets and reporting standards that let leadership compare channels and entities on one consistent basis.

Cross-channel programs

  • Lead the high-priority initiatives that span channels and no single team owns, such as measurement and incrementality, partner and agency consolidation, and AI adoption across the team.
  • Run them with clear scope, milestones and owners, and escalate early when they drift.
  • Conduct and synthesize ad hoc strategic analysis to support paid leadership with decision marking or problem solving

Insight and executive communication

  • Turn performance across channels and entities into a single, narrative for senior leadership: CMO updates, QBRs, steering decks and budget reviews.
  • Ensure high quality and consistent deliverable from the Paid team to Leadership to enable fast and informed decision making  

Organization and capability planning

  • Support org design, headcount and people-cost planning for Global Paid Marketing, working with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition.
  • Track priority hiring and internal moves, and keep one source of truth for the team's structure and capacity.
  • Drive knowledge transfer and best-practice sharing across channels and markets.

AI-enabled operations

  • Use AI to automate recurring reporting, business-review preparation and forecasting, freeing leaders' time for decisions.
  • Assess and introduce AI tools that improve planning, budget optimization and insight generation, and hold their output to account.

What you’ll bring

  • 6+ years in strategy and operations, growth strategy, management consulting or performance marketing at scale, including time close to senior decision-makers.
  • A strong quantitative foundation: you can build a budget or forecast model, read an experiment, and defend a recommendation with data rather than opinion. SQL or equivalent is a plus.
  • Fluency in marketing economics: CAC, payback, incrementality, and how budget, channel mix and volume trade off against each other.
  • Proven ability to run complex, cross-functional programs and to influence senior peers without direct authority.
  • Executive-level communication: you write crisp pre-reads, build decks that make a point on page one, and can tell leadership what they need to hear.
  • Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information, including budgets, organization plans and people topics.
  • Hands-on use of AI to compress real analytical or operational work, not just as a search engine.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities; you bring structure where there is none and keep many threads moving at once.

Bonus points if you have owned a planning or budget cycle end to end, worked in a multi-brand or multi-market organization, or come from a top-tier consulting or strategy program.

What success looks like in your first year

  • The paid operating cadence runs on a fixed calendar, with standard pre-reads and a decision log that leadership trusts and uses.
  • The next Business Plan and half-year budget submissions go in on time, from one source of truth, with every material assumption pressure-tested.
  • Two or three cross-channel programs have landed with measurable impact on CAC, volume or team productivity.
  • Recurring reporting and review preparation are largely automated, and leaders spend their time on decisions rather than slides.
  • Senior leadership gets one consistent, candid view of paid performance across channels and entities.

What we offer

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

  • You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.
  • Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.
  • Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.

Health & Wellbeing

  • Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.
  • Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.

Flexibility & Work-Life

  • Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.
  • Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.
  • Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.

Career & Development

  • Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.

Culture & Environment

  • Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.
  • We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.
